scenes.narration: Engine off, brakes released. Watch the air gauge. A single vehicle can lose at most 2 psi in a minute. A combination vehicle can lose at most 3.
scenes.key_fact: Brakes released: single 2 psi per minute, combination 3 psi per minute

scenes.narration: Now push the brake pedal down and hold it. The limits go up by one: a single vehicle can lose at most 3 psi in a minute, a combination at most 4.
scenes.key_fact: Brakes applied: single 3 psi per minute, combination 4 psi per minute

scenes.narration: Remember it as two, three, three, four. Released then applied, single then combination. More air can leak when the system is under pressure from an applied brake, and combinations have more lines to leak.
scenes.key_fact: 2-3 released, 3-4 applied. Anything faster means fix it before you drive.
